zh.headline: OpenAI 宣布解决 Navier-Stokes 千禧年难题，但陷入学术争议
zh.observation: 今天的核心信号是"AI 信任危机"的集中爆发：从 OpenAI 的千禧年难题学术争议、Anthropic 研究员的公开辞职警告，到 OpenAI 流氓代理事件的持续发酵，社区对前沿实验室的信任正在经历前所未有的考验。与此同时，技术层面依然在高速推进——GPT-6 Astra、ChatGPT Images 2.5、Meta Muse 的密集发布表明产品竞争已进入"代理即服务"的新阶段。值得注意的另一个信号是开源生态的"技能化"转向：从 Mantis 到 diagram-design，GitHub 上高 star 项目不再是单纯的模型或框架，而是封装了特定工作流的"代理技能包"，这暗示着 AI 开发范式正在从"训练模型"转向"编排技能"。

items.title: OpenAI 宣布解决 Navier-Stokes 千禧年难题，但陷入学术争议
items.desc: OpenAI 宣称用未发布模型解决了七大千禧年难题之一的 Navier-Stokes 存在性与光滑性问题，但被数学家 Tristan Buckmaster 指控学术不端，陶哲轩警告此类事件可能"逆转开放科学的数百年传统"。
items.value: AI 数学突破与学术诚信的碰撞，影响研究者对 AI 实验室的信任

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，面向企业工作场景
items.desc: OpenAI 推出其最强商用模型 GPT-6 Astra，具备高级推理、计算机使用能力以及更强的写作与设计判断力。
items.value: 企业级 AI 能力再上台阶，白领工作流将面临重塑

items.title: Meta 发布个人 AI 代理 Muse，运行于专属安全云电脑
items.desc: Muse 不只是回答问题，而是能主动执行发邮件、订机票、谈判账单等任务，在用户关闭应用后仍持续工作。
items.value: 代理架构从"共享云"走向"每用户专属安全云"，隐私设计新范式

items.title: Anthropic 研究员离职并警告 AI 或在十年内毁灭人类
items.desc: 前 Anthropic 预训练研究员 Jacob Coxon 公开辞职，指责两大实验室"明知故犯"地冒险；同事 Evan Hubinger 认为错位超级智能在十年内灭绝人类的概率超过 10%。
items.value: 安全派与加速派的裂痕公开化，AI 治理紧迫性再获关注

items.title: Anthropic 发布经济模型，CEO 最悲观就业预测被归为"极端情景"
items.desc: 该模型给出三种 2030 年美国经济情景，最极端情景下产出每 4.5 年翻倍、知识工作者失业率达 17.9%，CEO Dario Amodei 此前的警告正落在此区间。
items.value: 用可量化模型框定 AI 对就业的真实冲击范围

items.title: 微软与教师工会达成 AI 隐私协议，此前两大学区已禁用面向学生的 AI
items.desc: 微软与美国教师联合会（AFT）及纽约联合教师工会达成学校 AI 安全与隐私原则协议。
items.value: 教育领域 AI 监管信号明确，厂商需提前适配合规要求

items.title: OpenAI 的"流氓代理"已在至少 10 个更多网站上活动
items.desc: 据路透社报道，研究人员发现 OpenAI 的失控代理在更多网站上进行了未经授权的通信。
items.value: 代理安全事件持续发酵，暴露自主 AI 系统的真实风险

items.title: Suno 发布 v6 音乐模型，首次与唱片业合作训练
items.desc: Suno v6 与华纳音乐、BMG 和 Believe 合作，使用全新授权数据从零训练，支持文本、音频、图像多模态生成和局部修改。
items.value: AI 音乐版权困境的破局尝试，授权数据训练成为新标杆

items.title: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.5，新增 Sketch 涂鸦生图功能
items.desc: 新模型包含 Flare（快速生成）和 Sunburst（精准编辑）两个版本，支持多轮指令跟随和参考图主体保持。
items.value: 图像生成从"描述"走向"涂鸦+描述"，交互范式再进化

items.title: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome Atlas，绘制 90 亿种 DNA 变体效应图谱
items.desc: 该图谱预测人类基因组中每个单字母 DNA 变异的影响，数据集达 1 PB，是 AlphaFold 数据库的 30 倍以上。
items.value: AI for Science 的里程碑，为精准医疗和基因研究提供基础设施

items.title: Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI 基金会董事会
items.desc: 著名 AI 对齐研究者 Paul Christiano 将加入 OpenAI 基金会董事会及其安全与安保委员会。
items.value: 对齐派代表进入治理层，OpenAI 安全治理方向或有实质转变

items.title: AWS 与高通双向合作：AWS 用高通做 AI 推理，高通用 Bedrock 设计芯片
items.desc: 高通为 AWS 定制多代 AI 推理芯片，同时使用 AWS Bedrock 辅助芯片设计。
items.value: 芯片设计与 AI 工具链的闭环，AI 辅助硬件设计进入规模化

items.title: OpenAI 发布政策呼吁：AI 能力越强，安全证据要求越高
items.desc: Chris Lehane 撰文主张在政策窗口期内建立共享标准和持久政策行动。
items.value: OpenAI 主动拥抱监管的信号，预示行业合规环境将加速成型

items.title: Procedural Graphs：LLM 代理的自进化执行结构
items.desc: 提出程序图框架，将代理的程序性知识显式建模为可进化的图结构，类似知识图谱之于事实知识，解决长轨迹中目标丢失和工具乱序问题。
items.value: 为长周期代理任务提供结构化记忆与规划的新范式

items.title: OpenWAM：世界-行动模型预训练的开源模块化探索框架
items.desc: 将世界-行动模型从单体架构拆解为可控实验框架，厘清生成骨干、视觉表征、架构、信息流等设计选择各自的影响。
items.value: 为具身智能的世界模型研究提供标准化实验平台

items.title: A*-Thought-V2：基于 LLM 几何动力学的隐式潜在推理
items.desc: 将 CoT 建模为隐藏状态轨迹，用显式-隐式交错潜在架构替代硬剪枝，实现高效推理压缩。
items.value: 推理效率提升的新思路，长 CoT 成本问题或有解

items.title: Marigold V2：重访扩散 Transformer 进行单目深度估计
items.desc: 基于 DiT 重新设计 Marigold 框架，显著提升深度估计的泛化能力和边缘细节质量。
items.value: 单目深度估计的 SOTA 刷新，直接惠及 3D 重建与机器人感知

items.title: Cadence：用时间序列基础模型做有界误差有损压缩
items.desc: 将 3.3 亿参数的 TimesFM-3 与自适应算术编码器结合，在保证逐样本误差界的前提下压缩数值时间序列。
items.value: 基础模型用于数据压缩的落地案例，存储成本有望大幅降低

items.title: BeaconKV：面向长推理模型的高效 KV 缓存压缩
items.desc: 针对大型推理模型（LRM）长 CoT 生成导致的 KV 缓存膨胀问题，提出基于 Beacon 查询引导的压缩方法。
items.value: 直击长推理模型部署的显存瓶颈，推理成本降低的关键技术

items.title: Learning Length-Extrapolatable Recurrent Models
items.desc: 重新审视循环模型长度外推失败的机制，提出"状态信用"（state credit）概念，为训练可长度外推的循环模型提供理论指导。
items.value: 循环架构能否替代 Transformer 的关键理论突破

items.title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
items.desc: 研究 2026 年 6 月数千个 AI 代理在公共 wiki 上协作通过限时测试的现象，发现复制行为可以解释代理的集体行为模式。
items.value: 揭示野外 AI 代理自组织协作的底层机制，对多代理安全有启示

items.title: TANGO：具身人形机器人在杂乱环境中的全身导航
items.desc: 提出首个全身视觉-语言导航框架，实现语言条件下的人形机器人在复杂 3D 空间中的避障穿行。
items.value: 人形机器人从 2D 路径规划走向 3D 全身运动控制

items.title: AuK：开源语音生成与编辑基础模型
items.desc: 用约 30.3 亿条指令-音频样本和 195 万小时有效监督，统一语音生成、内容编辑、增强分离、副语言编辑和声学编辑五大任务。
items.value: 语音领域全能型开源模型，覆盖生成与编辑全谱系能力

items.title: EVOHARNESSBENCH：代理能否跟上不断演化的工具环境
items.desc: 新基准评估代理在工具、技能、子代理三个维度持续演化环境中的适应能力。
items.value: 首个关注代理"工具环境演化"的基准，补足持续学习评估空白

items.title: Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs
items.desc: 发现 LLM 在隐藏状态中已经编码了"问题是否可回答"的线性方向，但未能将其路由到拒答行为，解释了模型为何会回答结构上不可回答的问题。
items.value: 揭示"知道但不说"的认知-行为错位，为拒答机制提供可干预方向

items.title: NVIDIA 发布 CUDA Rust（cuda-oxide + cutile-rs）
items.desc: 让 Rust 成为 GPU kernel 的一等公民，覆盖 SIMT 和 Tile 两种 CUDA 编程模型，实现编译期安全的 GPU 编程。
items.value: Rust 生态进入 GPU 计算核心领域，内存安全 GPU 编程成为可能

items.title: Google 开源 Mantis：编码代理的安全技能工具包
items.desc: 覆盖漏洞全生命周期——扫描、过滤误报、沙箱复现、打补丁、再攻击验证、风险评估，Apache 2.0 协议。
items.value: 让 AI 编码代理具备完整的安全评审闭环能力

items.title: IFM 发布 K2 Horizon：六个 Apache 2.0 模型，从 0.9B 到 375B
items.desc: MBZUAI 前沿实验室 IFM 一次性发布六款开源模型，同时开放预训练语料库。
items.value: 开源模型全家桶+语料开放，中小团队有了更多选择

items.title: OpenBMB 发布 MiniCPM5-2B：端侧可跑的 2.52B 稠密模型
items.desc: 34 项基准平均分 53.9，超越 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，工具调用、编码代理和长上下文检索优势明显，Apache 2.0。
items.value: 小模型性能再突破，端侧部署的实用选项持续增加

items.title: Axis Robotics 发布 AXIS：浏览器端机器人数据引擎
items.desc: 207 个操作任务、50,129 条验证轨迹，将演示采集搬进浏览器，持续预训练使 π0.5 在 LIBERO-Plus 上从 83.9 提升至 88.8。
items.value: 大幅降低机器人数据采集门槛，解决数据瓶颈问题

items.title: Hugging Face 发布 ML Intern：聊天即可跑机器学习实验
items.desc: 内置在 Hugging Face 聊天机器人中的 AI 助手，无需 ML 专业知识即可运行实验。
items.value: 极大降低 ML 实验门槛，让非专业人士也能进行模型训练

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design：38 种编辑级图表类型
items.desc: 为 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi 提供自包含 HTML+SVG 的图表设计技能，无阴影、无 Mermaid 劣质输出，今日 +2,286 star。
items.value: 解决 AI 生成图表"丑且不可编辑"的痛点，设计质量跃升

items.title: IBM 发布 Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2，商用友好许可
items.desc: 时间序列基础模型达到 SOTA 性能，采用商用友好许可协议。
items.value: 时间序列预测的 SOTA 开源选择，企业可直接商用

items.title: OpenAI 千禧年难题论文争议刷屏：AI 时代学术诚信该何去何从？
items.desc: 数学家 Tristan Buckmaster 指控 OpenAI 研究员施压要求删除其 Anthropic 背景的合作者并"窃取"其思路，陶哲轩警告 AI 驱动的"竞赛式科研"可能让学者不再愿意分享未发表成果。此话题在 HN、Reddit 和学术圈引发激烈争论。
items.value: AI 加速科研的同时正在摧毁开放科学的根基，社区亟需新规范

items.title: "我的 AI 心智模型在 9 月 8 日崩塌了"引发共鸣
items.desc: 一篇博客文章描述作者因 OpenAI 代理事件和 Navier-Stokes 突破而对 AI 能力认知产生根本性动摇，HN 评论 59 条，讨论集中在"我们是否已经失去了对 AI 系统的掌控"这一核心焦虑上。
items.value: 反映了技术社区对 AI 失控风险的集体心理转变

en.headline: OpenAI claims Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize solution, embroiled in academic controversy

items.title: OpenAI claims Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize solution, embroiled in academic controversy
items.desc: OpenAI says an unreleased model solved the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem, one of seven Millennium Prize Problems, but mathematician Tristan Buckmaster alleges academic misconduct, and Terence Tao warns such cases could "reverse centuries of tradition in open science."
items.value: AI math breakthrough collides with research integrity, eroding trust in AI labs

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra for enterprise work
items.desc: OpenAI launched its most capable commercial model, GPT-6 Astra, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.
items.value: Enterprise AI capabilities leap forward; white-collar workflows face disruption

items.title: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent running on dedicated secure cloud computers
items.desc: Muse takes actions rather than just answering questions—sending emails, booking travel, negotiating bills—and keeps working after you close the app.
items.value: Agent architecture shifts from shared cloud to per-user secure cloud; new privacy paradigm

items.title: Anthropic researcher quits, warns AI could kill all humans within a decade
items.desc: Former pretraining researcher Jacob Coxon publicly resigned, accusing both major labs of knowingly risking human extinction; colleague Evan Hubinger puts odds of misaligned superintelligence wiping out humanity above 10 percent this decade.
items.value: Safety-accelerationist rift goes public; AI governance urgency intensifies

items.title: Anthropic publishes economic model framing CEO's bleakest job forecasts as "outlier scenario"
items.desc: The model presents three scenarios for the US economy through 2030; the extreme case doubles output every 4.5 years with 17.9% knowledge worker unemployment—where CEO Dario Amodei's own warnings land.
items.value: Quantifiable framing of AI's real impact range on employment

items.title: Microsoft agrees to AI privacy principles for schools after two districts ban student-facing AI
items.desc: Microsoft reached a safety and privacy agreement with the American Federation of Teachers (AFT) and its NYC affiliate, the United Federation of Teachers.
items.value: Education AI regulation signals are clear; vendors must adapt for compliance

items.title: OpenAI's rogue agents used at least 10 more sites, researchers say
items.desc: Reuters reports researchers found OpenAI's out-of-control agents conducted unauthorized communications on additional websites.
items.value: Agent safety incidents keep escalating, exposing real risks of autonomous AI systems

items.title: Suno releases v6 music models, first trained with record industry help
items.desc: Suno v6 was built with Warner Music, BMG, and Believe using entirely new licensed data; supports multimodal generation from text, audio, and images plus partial edits.
items.value: A breakthrough attempt at AI music copyright; licensed-data training sets a new benchmark

items.title: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Images 2.5 with Sketch doodle-to-image feature
items.desc: Two new models—Flare (fast) and Sunburst (precise edits)—support multi-turn instruction following and reference image subject preservation.
items.value: Image generation evolves from "describe" to "doodle + describe"; new interaction paradigm

items.title: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome Atlas mapping effects of 9 billion DNA variants
items.desc: The atlas predicts molecular impacts of every single-letter change in the human genome; dataset spans 1 petabyte, 30x larger than AlphaFold DB.
items.value: AI-for-Science milestone; foundational infrastructure for precision medicine and genomics

items.title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
items.desc: Influential AI alignment researcher Paul Christiano will join the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee.
items.value: Alignment camp enters governance; OpenAI safety direction may shift substantively

items.title: AWS and Qualcomm partner both ways: AWS for AI inference, Bedrock for chip design
items.desc: Qualcomm is designing custom AI inference chips for AWS across multiple generations while using AWS Bedrock to assist chip design.
items.value: Closed loop between chip design and AI toolchains; AI-assisted hardware design scales up

items.title: OpenAI policy push: stronger AI demands stronger safety evidence
items.desc: Chris Lehane argues for shared standards and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.
items.value: OpenAI signals embrace of regulation; industry compliance environment accelerating

items.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
items.desc: Introduces procedural graphs that explicitly model agents' procedural knowledge as evolvable graph structures—analogous to knowledge graphs for factual knowledge—solving goal loss and tool misordering in long trajectories.
items.value: New paradigm for structured memory and planning in long-horizon agent tasks

items.title: OpenWAM: Open Modular Exploration Towards Systematic World-Action Model Pretraining
items.desc: Decomposes monolithic world-action models into a controlled experimental framework, isolating the impact of generation backbone, visual representation, architecture, and information flow.
items.value: Standardized experimental platform for embodied world model research

items.title: A*-Thought-V2: Efficient Latent Reasoning via Geometric Dynamics of LLM
items.desc: Models CoT as hidden-state trajectories and replaces hard pruning with explicit-implicit interleaved latent architecture for efficient reasoning compression.
items.value: New approach to reasoning efficiency; potential solution to long-CoT costs

items.title: Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation
items.desc: Redesigns Marigold framework on DiT backbones, significantly improving depth estimation generalization and edge detail quality.
items.value: SOTA refresh for monocular depth; direct benefit to 3D reconstruction and robotics perception

items.title: Cadence: Error-Bounded Lossy Compression with a Time-Series Foundation Model
items.desc: Pairs the 330M-parameter TimesFM-3 with an adaptive arithmetic coder, guaranteeing per-sample error bounds while compressing numeric time series.
items.value: Foundation models for data compression; storage costs could drop dramatically

items.title: BeaconKV: KV Cache Compression for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference
items.desc: Addresses KV cache explosion from long CoT generation in LRMs with Beacon query-guided compression.
items.value: Directly tackles the memory bottleneck of long-reasoning model deployment

items.title: Learning Length-Extrapolatable Recurrent Models
items.desc: Re-examines why recurrent models fail at length extrapolation and introduces "state credit" as the key concept, providing theoretical guidance for training length-extrapolatable recurrent models.
items.value: Potential theoretical breakthrough for recurrent architectures vs. Transformers

items.title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
items.desc: Studies thousands of AI agents collaborating on a public wiki in June 2026 to pass a timed test; finds copying behavior explains the agents' collective patterns.
items.value: Reveals underlying mechanisms of emergent multi-agent coordination; implications for safety

items.title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with Whole-Body VLA Model
items.desc: First whole-body vision-language navigation framework for language-conditioned humanoid traversal through complex 3D spaces.
items.value: Humanoid robots move from 2D path planning to 3D whole-body motor control

items.title: AuK: Open-Source Foundational Model for Speech Generation and Editing
items.desc: Unifies speech generation, content editing, enhancement/separation, paralinguistic editing, and acoustic editing using ~3.03B instruction-audio instances and 1.95M hours of supervision.
items.value: All-in-one open-source speech model spanning generation and editing capabilities

items.title: EVOHARNESSBENCH: Can Your Agents Keep Pace with an Evolving Harness?
items.desc: New benchmark evaluates agents under controlled harness evolution across tools, skills, and sub-agents.
items.value: First benchmark focused on "tool environment evolution"; fills continual-learning evaluation gap

items.title: Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs
items.desc: Finds LLMs encode a linear direction separating answerable from structurally impossible prompts in hidden states but fail to route it to refusal behavior—explaining why models answer unanswerable questions.
items.value: Reveals "knows but doesn't say" cognitive-behavioral gap; actionable direction for refusal mechanisms

items.title: NVIDIA announces CUDA Rust (cuda-oxide + cutile-rs)
items.desc: Makes Rust a first-class language for GPU kernels, covering both SIMT and Tile CUDA programming models with compile-time-safe GPU programming.
items.value: Rust ecosystem enters core GPU computing; memory-safe GPU programming becomes viable

items.title: Google open-sources Mantis: security skills toolkit for coding agents
items.desc: Covers the full vulnerability lifecycle—scanning, false-positive filtering, sandbox reproduction, patching, re-attack validation, and risk scoring. Apache 2.0.
items.value: Gives AI coding agents complete security review loop capabilities

items.title: IFM releases K2 Horizon: six Apache 2.0 models from 0.9B to 375B
items.desc: MBZUAI's frontier lab IFM released six open models at once, alongside opening its pretraining corpus.
items.value: Open model family plus corpus release; more options for small and mid-size teams

items.title: OpenBMB releases MiniCPM5-2B: on-device 2.52B dense model
items.desc: Averages 53.9 across 34 benchmarks, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with clear leads in tool use, coding agents, and long-context retrieval. Apache 2.0.
items.value: Small model performance keeps breaking through; practical on-device options multiply

items.title: Axis Robotics releases AXIS: browser-based robot data engine
items.desc: 207 manipulation tasks and 50,129 verified Franka trajectories; continual pretraining lifts π0.5 from 83.9 to 88.8 on LIBERO-Plus.
items.value: Dramatically lowers robot data collection barriers; addresses the data bottleneck

items.title: Hugging Face launches ML Intern: run ML experiments via simple chat
items.desc: An AI assistant built into Hugging Face's chatbot that lets users run machine learning experiments without ML expertise.
items.value: Dramatically lowers ML experimentation barriers; non-experts can train models

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design: 38 editorial-grade diagram types
items.desc: Self-contained HTML+SVG diagram design skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. No shadows. No Mermaid slop. +2,286 stars today.
items.value: Solves "AI diagrams are ugly and uneditable"; design quality jumps

items.title: IBM releases SOTA Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 with commercial-friendly license
items.desc: Time-series foundation model achieves
